<p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
Invited talks, press coverage, scientific committee roles, and workshop organisation.
</p>

<div id="media-app"></div>

<script>
const ITEMS = [
  // ── Talks ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  {cat:"talk", date:"April 2026", venue:"Homerton College, University of Cambridge",
   title:"From Accuracy to Guarantees: Neuro-Symbolic Intelligence and Cyber-Graph Architectures for Safe, Real-Time Battery Systems",
   desc:"Advanced Battery Manufacturing Workshop, co-organised by EU Horizon Europe projects BATTwin, AM4BAT, and BatCAT. How AI can move beyond average-case accuracy toward provable safety in real-time battery systems — combining learning-based models with structured constraint enforcement to enable adaptive intelligence while ensuring only safe actions are possible by design.",
   url:""},

  {cat:"talk", date:"January 2026", venue:"University of Limerick",
   title:"From Seen to Unseen: Learning Beyond Data Abundance",
   desc:"CRT-AI ML Week 2026, hosted by Prof. Tiziana Margaria. Zero-Shot Learning, knowledge-driven generalization, energy-efficient AI — why scaling data and parameters is not enough for rare and safety-critical scenarios.",
   url:""},

  {cat:"talk", date:"January 2026", venue:"Halden, Norway",
   title:"Panel: Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence",
   desc:"1st International Conference on Human-Centric AI (ICHCAI 2026), Institute for Energy Technology. Topics: Trustworthy AI, explainability, human-in-the-loop systems.",
   url:""},

  {cat:"talk", date:"2024", venue:"Kaiserslautern, Germany",
   title:"Bridging Logic and Learning: Neural-Symbolic Approach for Enhanced Reasoning (ASPER)",
   desc:"DCLXVI International Workshop. Answer Set Programming, neural-symbolic integration, knowledge encoding in deep learning.",
   url:"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2312.11651"},

  {cat:"talk", date:"2024", venue:"Kaiserslautern, Germany",
   title:"Symbolic-AI-Fusion Deep Learning (SAIF-DL): Encoding Knowledge into Training",
   desc:"DCLXVI International Workshop. ASP loss penalties, ontology-driven training, trustworthy deep learning.",
   url:"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2411.08463"},

  {cat:"talk", date:"February 2025", venue:"DTE AICOMAS",
   title:"Predicting Battery Degradation Using Cellular Neural Network Model",
   desc:"Digital Twin Technology for Battery Cell Manufacturing Symposium. Cellular neural networks, lightweight models, efficient temporal prediction.",
   url:""},

  // ── Scientific Committee ───────────────────────────────
  {cat:"committee", date:"2026", venue:"NMBU & Soundsensing",
   title:"Scientific Committee Member — Battery RUL Estimation Competition",
   desc:"Competition for estimation of remaining useful life of batteries, with cash prizes totalling 50,000 NOK. Datasets collected from real battery sensors deployed across buildings in Norway. Committee: Fadi Al Machot (NMBU), Mina Farmanbar (UiS), Kyandoghere Kyamakya (University of Klagenfurt), Habib Ullah (NMBU), Ibrahim Abdelfattah Abdelhameed (NMBU).",
   url:"https://lnkd.in/eBs8D2A3"},

  {cat:"committee", date:"2026", venue:"NORA",
   title:"Scientific Committee Member — NORA Norwegian AI Research Consortium",
   desc:"Member of the scientific committee for NORA – The Norwegian Artificial Intelligence Research Consortium, coordinating AI research across Norwegian universities and research institutions.",
   url:"https://www.nora.ai"},

  {cat:"committee", date:"2025", venue:"NMBU",
   title:"Panel Convenor — NorDev25",
   desc:"Panel: AI and Sustainable Development: Opportunities, Challenges, and Ethical Considerations. Norwegian Developer Conference, NMBU, September 2025.",
   url:""},

  // ── Workshop Organisation ──────────────────────────────
  {cat:"workshop", date:"2026", venue:"Part of JOWO 2026",
   title:"Co-Organiser & PC — OSETAI 2026: Ontology and Semantics for Explainable and Trustworthy AI",
   desc:"As AI systems are increasingly deployed in real-world and safety-critical environments, explainability, trustworthiness, accountability, and interpretability are becoming foundational requirements. Topics: causal reasoning, counterfactual explanations, explainable neural models, symbolic and neuro-symbolic reasoning, digital forensics, AI auditing, regulatory compliance, metadata and semantic standards, trust, provenance, and reproducibility in AI. Submission deadline: to be announced.",
   url:"http://www.inprodat.de/events/osetai-2026"},

  {cat:"workshop", date:"2024–2025", venue:"Kaiserslautern, Germany",
   title:"Co-Organiser — DCLXVI Workshop 2024 & 2025",
   desc:"Designing the Conceptual Landscape for an XAIR Validation Infrastructure. Part of the BATCAT Horizon Europe project.",
   url:"https://batcat.info/dclxvi/"},

  {cat:"workshop", date:"2016", venue:"Salzburg, Austria",
   title:"Organiser — AHA Workshop at ER 2016",
   desc:"International Workshop on Conceptual Modeling for Ambient Assistance and Healthy Ageing, co-located with the 35th International Conference on Conceptual Modeling (ER 2016).",
   url:""},

  // ── YouTube ────────────────────────────────────────────
  {cat:"press", date:"Ongoing", venue:"YouTube",
   title:"YouTube Channel — Lectures & Research Talks",
   desc:"Course lectures, research demonstrations, and talks on machine learning, neural-symbolic AI, zero-shot learning, and temporal data analysis.",
   url:"https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC82GJ66Ax6AEORXeGI4P6ig"},
];

const CATS = {
  all: "All",
  talk: "Talks",
  committee: "Scientific Committee",
  workshop: "Workshop & Organisation",
  press: "Media & Press"
};

const CBADGE = {
  talk:      "background:#E1F5EE;color:#085041",
  committee: "background:#EEEDFE;color:#3C3489",
  workshop:  "background:#e8f1fb;color:#0c447c",
  press:     "background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806"
};

let activeCat = "all";

function render() {
  const filtered = ITEMS.filter(i => activeCat === "all" || i.cat === activeCat);

  const filters = Object.entries(CATS).map(([k,v]) => {
    const on = activeCat === k;
    const style = on
      ? "background:#1a3a5c;color:white;border-color:#1a3a5c;"
      : "background:white;color:#6c757d;border-color:#dde4ed;";
    const count = k === "all" ? ITEMS.length : ITEMS.filter(i=>i.cat===k).length;
    return `<span onclick="setCat('${k}')" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid;cursor:pointer;${style}">${v} <span style="opacity:0.7">${count}</span></span>`;
  }).join("");

  const items = filtered.map(i => {
    const badge = `<span style="font-size:9px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;margin-right:6px;${CBADGE[i.cat]}">${CATS[i.cat]}</span>`;
    const link = i.url ? `<a href="${i.url}" target="_blank" style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#2d7dd2;">More info →</a>` : "";
    return `<div style="padding:1rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f4;">
      <div style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#6c757d;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:4px;">
        ${badge}${i.date} · ${i.venue}
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;margin-bottom:4px;">${i.title}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#6c757d;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:4px;">${i.desc}</div>
      ${link}
    </div>`;
  }).join("");

  document.getElementById("media-app").innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:20px;">${filters}</div>
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:12px;">Showing <strong>${filtered.length}</strong> of <strong>${ITEMS.length}</strong> items</div>
    ${items}
  `;
}

function setCat(cat) {
  activeCat = cat;
  render();
}

render();
</script>

</div>
